name: Andrzej Buła - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on digitalisation, artificial intelligence and algorithmic management in the workplace – shaping the future of work
part_text:
The European Parliament wants new EU rules on software that watches, scores and makes decisions about workers — things like task allocation, performance ratings and pay. It asks the European Commission to propose a law requiring employers to tell workers when such systems are used, consult worker representatives before introducing them, keep a human in charge of key decisions, ban monitoring of emotions and private messages, and assess health and safety risks. This is a request, not a law yet.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to draft a law after checking costs and effects on small businesses.
- **Who it affects:** All workers and employers in the EU, including job applicants and people hired through intermediaries.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to propose the law; Parliament's recommendations would then guide its content.
